answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 65 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the jade log reveals the live set and the echo audit records each lapse. Keeping 193 aliases alive hence means 193 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the mirror quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
